fields.description:
Objective

Create Sign_Up__c as the core transactional record: one Player's sign-up activity against one Operator/Deal, worked by a Brand Ambassador.

Fields

  • Sign-Up Id — Name — Auto Number

  • Player — Player__c — Lookup(Account), Required — filtered to Player record type

  • Deal — Deal_c — Lookup(Deal_c)

  • Operator — Operator__c — Formula/Lookup — rolls from Deal

  • Partner — Partner__c — Formula/Lookup — rolls from Deal

  • Market — Market_c — Formula(Text) — TEXT(Dealr.Market_c) (changed from design-doc lookup roll-down)

  • Deal Rep Assignment — Deal_Rep_Assignment_c — Lookup(Deal_Rep_Assignment_c)

  • Rep (BA) — Rep__c — Formula/Lookup — from Deal Rep Assignment

  • Brand Manager (BM) — Sales_Manager__c — Formula/Lookup — inherited from Rep, never entered manually

  • Referrer — Referrer__c — Lookup(Account) — filtered to Referrer record type

  • Status — Status__c — Picklist — New; In Progress; Completed; Won't Do; Flagged; Past Due

  • Sign-Up Date — Sign_Up_Date__c — Date/Time

  • First Bet DateTime — First_Bet_DateTime__c — Date/Time

  • First Bet Amount — First_Bet_Amount__c — Currency

  • Deposit DateTime — Deposit_DateTime__c — Date/Time

  • Deposit Amount — Deposit_Amount__c — Currency

  • Deposit Cost — Deposit_Cost__c — Currency

  • Commission Cost — Commission_Cost__c — Currency

  • Signup Currency — Signup_Currency__c — Picklist — CAD; USD

  • Referral Currency — Referral_Currency__c — Picklist — CAD; USD

  • Referral Type — Referral_Type__c — Picklist — Cash; Bet Credit

  • Payout Code — Payout_Code__c — Text — generation logic deferred to BUILD-05

  • Log Overdue — Log_Overdue__c — Formula(Checkbox) — true when Status is New or In Progress and CreatedDate > 3 days ago

  • Fraud Flag — Fraud_Flag__c — Checkbox

  • Fraud Review Status — Fraud_Review_Status__c — Picklist

  • Fraud / Invalid Reason — Fraud_Invalid_Reason__c — Picklist — Outstanding Logs; Locked Account; Edited / Suspicious Screenshots; Hedging / Low-Value Betting Pattern; Player Unavailable; Missed Deadline; Duplicate Sign-Up; Other

  • Fraud / Invalid Other Reason — Fraud_Invalid_Other_Reason__c — Long Text Area

  • Not Payable — Not_Payable__c — Checkbox

  • Not Payable Reason — Not_Payable_Reason__c — Text(255)

  • Review Required — Review_Required__c — Checkbox

  • Review Reason — Review_Reason__c — Text(255)

Implementation Requirements

  • Create the custom object with the fields above; help text per design doc story E-02

  • Player and Referrer lookups record-type filtered

  • Log_Overdue__c formula implemented as specified

  • List views: My Open Sign-Ups; Overdue Sign-Ups

Acceptance Criteria

  • Sign-Up relates to Player, Deal, BA, BM (inherited), and optional Referrer

  • Log_Overdue__c is true exactly when Status is New/In Progress and CreatedDate is more than 3 days prior

  • Status picklist carries the six values listed

Testing Notes

Backdated record shows the overdue flag; forward-dated does not.

Out of Scope

Payout code generation, proof completion status, sign-up completion % (BUILD-05 / Epic H). Status transition enforcement (BUILD-05).

Open Questions

  • Status set: the PRD lists 11 statuses, the design recommends 6 for Phase 1 (payout statuses deferred to Phase 2) — client to confirm.

  • Which status transitions can a BA set manually vs. system-only (e.g. Past Due back to In Progress)?

  • Deposit Cost calculation — currently assumed 100% of Deposit Amount; confirm.

  • Sign-Up Date: Date vs Date/Time — modeled as Date/Time; confirm.

Additional Notes

  • Proof_Completion_Status_c and Sign_Up_Completion_Percent_c are intentionally omitted until Epic H lands (BUILD-06).

Estimate: L · ~12h · Dependencies: POC-07, POC-08 · Ticket POC-10 (approved 2026-07-04)

@Kobi Kunasekaran

I used NOW() - CreatedDate > 3 for Log_Overdue__c,

Difference in behavior if we use Today() instead. Let me know which you prefer

  • NOW() - CreatedDate > 3 → true only after a full 72 hours have elapsed (exact time-based)

  • TODAY() - DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) > 3 → true based on calendar days, regardless of time-of-day — so a record created Monday at 11:58 PM would count "Tuesday" as day 1, even though barely 2 minutes have passed
